creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers cloud cybersecurity and compliance software in full and shows no creative activity. 'State-of-the-art', developer APIs and custom scripts are traps or non-creative.

community.reason: Level 2: several specific current external education and community investment activities plus employee onboarding, but no participant, dollar or reach figures to support level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current activities (a disability training and job-placement program and a multi-religion holiday calendar with cultural initiatives) with no reach figures; demographic statistics alone add no level.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: small and medium-sized business customers are served through inside sales, with no specific enabling program for founders or small businesses.

notes: E1 (disability training and job placements) is counted once each for Community and Cross-cultural, because it independently meets both themes' criteria. Training programs offered to customers as part of subscriptions were not counted: this is customer education tied to the product. Required harassment and EEO training was not counted because it is compliance training. Free services offered to 'organizations of all sizes' and third-party developer APIs are not aimed at small-business barriers, so they were not scored as enabling. The Item 7 excerpt only repeats the Item 1 customer description. Environmental clean-up activities were noted but not scored, as no figures were given and they do not change the level.
